title.zh: 星星为什么会一闪一闪

content.zh: 星星的光要穿过地球的空气才能到我们眼睛里。空气一直在流动，忽冷忽热，光被推得歪来歪去，看起来就像在眨眼睛。
content.en: Starlight must pass through our air to reach us. The moving air bends the light this way and that, so the stars seem to twinkle.

title.zh: 太阳为什么总也烧不完
title.en: Why Does the Sun Never Burn Out?

content.zh: 太阳不是在"烧东西"，而是中心把氢变成氦，放出巨大的光和热。它还有够用几十亿年的氢，所以不会马上烧完。
content.en: The sun is not burning fuel like a fire. Deep inside it turns hydrogen into helium, releasing light and heat. It has hydrogen for billions of years yet.

content.zh: 太空里有许多小石块，飞进地球空气时和空气猛烈摩擦，变得又烫又亮，划出一道光。大多数还没落地就烧没了。
content.en: Small rocks in space rub hard against our air when they fall in. They get so hot that they glow and streak across the sky. Most burn up before landing.

content.zh: 黑洞是引力特别特别大的地方，连跑得最快的光都逃不出来，所以它看起来黑黑的。它并不是一个真的洞。
content.en: A black hole is a place with gravity so strong that even light cannot escape, so it looks black. It is not a hole you could fall through.

title.zh: 地球为什么不会掉下去
title.en: Why Does Earth Not Fall Down?

content.zh: 太空中没有"上"和"下"，也没有地面可以掉下去。地球一直绕着太阳转，太阳的引力拉住它，它就稳稳地跑在轨道上。
content.en: In space there is no up or down, and no floor to fall to. Earth keeps moving around the sun, and the sun’s gravity holds it in its path.

title.zh: 我们为什么只看到月亮的一面
title.en: Why Do We Only See One Side of the Moon?

content.zh: 月亮自己转一圈的时间和绕地球转一圈的时间刚好一样长，所以它总是用同一面朝着我们，背面我们在地球上永远看不到。
content.en: The moon takes exactly as long to spin once as to circle the Earth. So it always keeps the same face towards us, and we never see the far side.

title.zh: 土星为什么有一圈光环

content.zh: 土星周围围着无数冰块和石头，大的像房子，小的像沙粒。它们绕着土星转，从远处看连成一圈亮亮的光环。
content.en: Countless chunks of ice and rock orbit Saturn, some house-sized and some like grains of sand. From far away they look like one bright ring.

title.zh: 彗星为什么拖着长尾巴
title.en: Why Do Comets Have Long Tails?

content.zh: 彗星是个"脏雪球"，飞近太阳时受热，里面的冰变成气体往外喷，被太阳风吹向后方，就拖出一条长长的尾巴。
content.en: A comet is a dirty snowball. Near the sun it warms up and its ice turns to gas, which the solar wind blows backwards into a long tail.

content.zh: 火星的地面上全是含铁的尘土，铁生锈以后是红褐色的，整颗星球看上去就是红色的，像一颗生锈的大石头。
content.en: Mars is covered in dust containing iron. When iron rusts it turns reddish-brown, so the whole planet looks red, like a rusty rock.

title.en: Is the Milky Way a River?

content.zh: 银河不是河，而是无数颗星星挤在一起，密得连成一条亮带。我们住在银河系里面，所以它看上去像横过天空的一条河。
content.en: The Milky Way is not a river. It is countless stars packed so tightly that they form a bright band. We live inside it, so it looks like a river across the sky.

title.en: Where Do Stars Go in the Daytime?

content.zh: 星星一直挂在天上，白天也没走开。只是太阳把空气照得太亮，星星那点光比不过太阳光，我们的眼睛就看不见它们了。
content.en: The stars are there all day too. Sunlight makes the air so bright that the faint starlight is lost in it, so our eyes cannot pick them out.

title.en: Why Do We Have Four Seasons?

content.zh: 地球是斜着身子绕太阳转的。转到某一边朝向太阳时，白天长、阳光直，就是夏天；转到另一边斜着晒，就是冬天。
content.en: Earth leans over as it goes around the sun. When one side leans towards the sun, days are long and the light is direct — summer. Leaning away gives winter.
